source_note: External Codex (GPT-5 Codex 2026-05-23) proposal-mode iter-1 findings. 7 findings: 2 CRITICAL, 3 WARNING, 2 SUGGESTION. All findings verified actionable (no staleness). Codex caught real in-context anchoring residue — particularly EC1 (install-vs-repo-state gap) and EC2 (command file vs skill file distinction).
pushback_verification: All 7 external findings verified against current artifact + file state at walk-time. EW1 verified: 3 baseline specs (orbit-run-summary-emit:23, orbit-conventions:207, orbit-archive-modifications:68) still reference #6 sync-specs removal language; .claude/commands/opsx/sync.md still ships. EC1 verified: overlay cp -r model doesn't delete target-only files. EC2 verified: .claude/commands/opsx/onboard.md still has upstream Phase 1-8 + openspec new change content. EW2 verified against orbit-onboard spec Setup verification scenarios. EW3 verified against orbit-conventions Overlay file disposition requirement. ES2 verified: design.md:146 said 'Three categories' then listed 4. No stale findings to suppress.

resolutions.action: Multi-part resolution. (a) Added task 1.2: delete .claude/commands/opsx/sync.md from overlay. (b) Added MODIFIED Internal-run JSON summary format requirement to orbit-conventions delta — full requirement copy with the sync_specs parenthetical rephrased from '#6 will deprecate/remove' to 'retained under pegging strategy per Distribution model'. (c) Created new orbit-run-summary-emit delta file with MODIFIED Emit scope requirement — full requirement copy with the /opsx:sync-specs bullet rephrased from 'deprecated upstream; slated for removal by #6' to 'primitive only under pegging strategy; user-callable command sync.md pruned'. (d) Updated proposal.md Modified Capabilities to add orbit-run-summary-emit + extra orbit-conventions modification. (e) Updated design.md with additional MODIFY items (4 and 5) documenting these spec changes.

Added task 3.6: document explicit `rm -rf .claude/skills/feedback` and `rm -f .claude/commands/opsx/sync.md` commands in README install, update, and uninstall sections. Rationale: overlay cp -r doesn't delete target-only files. Updated task 3.4 reference to fresh-sandbox verification asserting absence. Added install-model implication (#6 in design.md) explaining the overlay model gap and the doc-only enforcement pending install-script #26. Updated orbit-conventions Overlay file disposition Not-shipped scenario to note absence-in-overlay is necessary but not sufficient; README must document rm steps.

resolutions.action: Rewrote task 4.7: instead of 'verify .claude/commands/opsx/onboard.md correctly resolves' (assumption-based), now explicitly 'Rewrite .claude/commands/opsx/onboard.md with the same 5-section orbit-authored content as the new SKILL.md (per the existing opsx-command pattern of duplicate-content — see propose.md for reference)'. Added grep-verification for old guided-tour residue (`openspec new change`, `Phase 4`, `do real work in their codebase`).

Rewrote orbit-onboard spec `Setup verification section` requirement scenarios. Replaced 'at least one orbit-specific directory (e.g., openspec/lenses/ or openspec/explore/)' with stable post-install artifacts: .claude/skills/openspec-review/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/openspec-audit-drift/SKILL.md, .claude/commands/opsx/review.md, .claude/commands/opsx/address-reviews.md. Added new scenario `Verify pruned upstream files are absent` to assert absence of .claude/skills/feedback/ and .claude/commands/opsx/sync.md per the EC1 prune-step pattern.

Added 2 new scenarios to orbit-conventions Overlay file disposition requirement: `Commands follow the same 4-category framework` (enumerates orbit-authored vs orbit-modified vs upstream-required-primitive vs not-shipped for command files, with examples mapping current commands to categories) and `Command-file disposition documented in the same change as a removal or addition` (analogous to per-skill disposition rule, with rm-step requirement for pruned commands).

Filed 2 GH issues with full context: [openspec-orbit#27](https://github.com/las-sal/openspec-orbit/issues/27) for Option 2 (drop `# Orbit additions` pattern) at P2, and [openspec-orbit#28](https://github.com/las-sal/openspec-orbit/issues/28) for the global `openspec-*` → `orbit-*` rename at P3. Both reference the lean-overlay-and-add-orbit-onboard change as the predecessor that declares the pegging strategy. Updated design.md Non-Goals to reference #27 and #28 (replacing 'tracked as next explore cycle' and 'in its own change' language). Added task 5.7 (marked done) documenting the filing in tasks.md.

Edit folded into the larger D-conventions-1 rewrite in design.md (which also added the new MODIFY items 4-5 and the install-model implication item 6 per EW1+EC1). The 'Three categories:' phrase was replaced with 'Four categories:' in the rewritten paragraph.

final_assessment: All 7 external findings resolved (4 decisions, 3 trivial fixes). 2 new orbit GH issues filed (#27 Option 2, #28 Global rename). Substantive scope additions: now 13 deltas across 3 capabilities (was 11 across 2); 28 tasks across 5 chunks (was 25). Codex caught real in-context anchoring residue — EC1 install-vs-repo-state gap and EC2 command-file-vs-skill-file distinction were both genuine blind spots. EW1 surfaced baseline-spec language drift from the just-closed #6 framing. Validates --strict.
